svg.aria-label: Bar chart of Living Planet Index change by system, 1970 to 2020
svg.text: Living Planet Index: average change in monitored wildlife populations, 1970-2020
Average change in population size. Not a count of species lost. Source: WWF and ZSL, Living Planet Report 2024.
Index covers about 35,000 monitored populations of 5,495 species of amphibians, birds, fish, mammals and reptiles.
Freshwater populations fell furthest; marine populations fell least among the three systems, but still by more than half.
Data: WWF (2024) Living Planet Report 2024. Chart drawn from the published figures only.
